## Jury, author, title

The general configuration for the cover page lives in `_quarto.yml` and `_quarto-en.yml` — see the [online documentation](https://zinc75.github.io/quarto-cnam-thesis/en/).


## Render the document

Terminal commands, **at the project root** (VSCode and Positron offer integrated commands via an extension, but the command line is universal):


:::: {layout="[ 34, -5, 55 ]"}

::: {}
Full PDF + HTML render:

```bash
quarto render --profile en
```
:::

::: {}
PDF only:

```bash
quarto render --profile en --to cnam-thesis-pdf
```
:::

::::



Live preview (automatic rebuild on every saved change to your thesis):

```bash
quarto preview --profile en --to cnam-thesis-pdf
```


```{=latex}
% Local-only: put the cheat-sheet table on its own landscape page(s) for readability,
% and colour inline code (\texttt) inside it. No background box so that long commands
% still break at line end. All scoped by landscape + \begingroup/\endgroup.
\begin{landscape}
\begingroup
\definecolor{cnamcodefg}{HTML}{6B3FA0}
\let\cnamOrigTexttt\texttt
\renewcommand{\texttt}[1]{\cnamOrigTexttt{\textcolor{cnamcodefg}{#1}}}
```

## Useful Markdown commands


| Category | Description | Markdown  | Online documentation |
|:-----|:---------------|:------------------|:-----:|
| ===      |             |                    |      |
| [Structure]{rs=4} | • Chapter / section / subsection title | `# Title` · `## Section` · `### Subsection` | [docs][d-headings] |
| ^ | • Unnumbered section | `## Title {.unnumbered}` | [docs][d-numbering] |
| ^ | • Short title (running head / table of contents) | `# Long title {short-title="Short"}` | [docs][d-shorttitle] |
| ^ | • Page break | `{{</* pagebreak */>}}` | [docs][d-pagebreak] |
| ===      |             |                    |      |
| [Formatting]{rs=4} | • Bold · italic | `**bold**` · `*italic*` | [docs][d-inline] |
| ^ | • Inline code | `` `code` `` | [docs][d-inline] |
| ^ | • Underlined text | `[text]{.underline}` | [docs][d-inline] |
| ^ | • Lists (bullets / numbered) | `- item` · `1. item` | [docs][d-lists] |
| ===      |             |                    |      |
| Bibliography | • Citation (IEEE style -> `[N]`) | `[@key]` | [docs][d-citations] |
| ===      |             |                    |      |
| Links | • Link to a URL | `[text](https://example.org)` | [docs][d-links] |
| ===      |             |                    |      |
| [Figures]{rs=2} | • Image with caption and label | `![Caption](images/x.png){#fig-x width=70%}` | [docs][d-figstatic] |
| ^ | • Code-generated figure | `{python}` block + `#| label: fig-x` | [docs][d-figpython] |
| ===      |             |                    |      |
| [Mathematics]{rs=3} | • Inline equation | `$E = mc^2$` | [docs][d-eqinline] |
| ^ | • Numbered display equation | `$$ ... $$ {#eq-x}` | [docs][d-eqblock] |
| ^ | • System of equations | `$$\begin{cases} ... \end{cases}$$` | [docs][d-eqsys] |
| ===      |             |                    |      |
| [Tables]{rs=2} | • Simple Markdown table | headers + `|:--|--:|` row | [docs][d-tablesimple] |
| ^ | • Enhanced table (`quartable`) | `[x]{rs=2}` · `[x]{cs=2}` · `===` | [docs][d-quartable] |
| ===      |             |                    |      |
| [Cross-references]{rs=2} | • Set a label on a target | `## Title {#sec-label}` | [docs][d-crossref] |
| ^ | • Reference (section / figure / table / equation) | `@sec-label` · `@fig-label` · `@tbl-label` · `@eq-label` | [docs][d-crossref] |
| ===      |             |                    |      |
| Callouts | • Callout box | `::: {.callout-note}` · `.callout-tip` · `.callout-warning` · `.callout-important` … `:::` | [docs][d-callouts] |
| ===      |             |                    |      |
| [Code]{rs=2} | • Displayed code block | ```` ``` ```` + language (e.g. `python`) | [docs][d-codedisplay] |
| ^ | • Executed code block | ```` ``` ```` + `{python}` | [docs][d-codeexec] |
| ===      |             |                    |      |
| [Acronyms]{rs=3} | • Declare an acronym | `{{</* acr id ABBR "Full form" */>}}` | [docs][d-glossary] |
| ^ | • Declare a glossary term | `{{</* terme id "word" "meaning" */>}}` | [docs][d-glossary] |
| ^ | • Use (first / short / long) | `{{</* acrf id */>}}` · `{{</* acrs id */>}}` · `{{</* acrl id */>}}` | [docs][d-glossary] |
| ===      |             |                    |      |
| Proofreading comments | • Margin annotation (`comment` · `todo` · `note` · `question`) | `{{</* comment "your remark" author="xx" */>}}` | [docs][d-comments] |
